notes: Every promise is conditional on another person, so each is speculative and Low, with its date. T-G13, T-G14 and T-G4: 'a.m.' and 'Inc.' do not end the sentence, and getting paid is not the speaker's own step.

items.title: Call the tent rental
items.quote: I'll call the tent rental at 9 a.m. Friday if the treasurer signs off.
items.note: A capital after a.m. is the weekday, not a new sentence.

items.title: Ship the banners to Lakeside Signs
items.quote: I'll ship the banners to Lakeside Signs Inc. on Monday if the deposit clears.
items.note: 'Inc.' before lowercase does not end the sentence.

items.title: Pay the stage crew
items.quote: I'll pay the stage crew on Thursday once I get paid by the sponsors.
items.note: Waiting to be paid is a condition, even with subject I.
